course.title: Crane Operation Basics
course.shortDescription: Understand crane operation and safe lifting practices.
course.description: Learn the fundamentals of crane operation, lifting equipment inspection, heavy machinery safety and crane controls.
learningOutcomes: Identify hazards around heavy construction machinery.
Recognize the importance of safe lifting practices.
course.safetyNotice: This is an introductory educational course, not professional crane operator training or certification. Actual crane operation requires appropriate training, authorization, supervision and compliance with applicable safety regulations.
course.optionalGameNotice: The supplied game is a pipe-connecting puzzle, not a crane simulator. It is not available in the portal yet because the source repository has no license granting permission to copy or redistribute it.
